$comment: Supported boards: one firmware image per board. Read by the CI build matrix (.github/workflows/firmware-package.yml) and documented in docs/modes.md. 'defaults' is applied on top of sdkconfig.defaults (and the target's sdkconfig.defaults.<target>); 'capabilities' must match what the build enables (hub_config::capabilities()); 'preset' is CONFIG_HUB_PROFILE_*.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-A7670E-4G
boards.notes: Main board: LTE Cat-1 modem, 18650 holder with solar input, MAX17048 battery gauge.

boards.name: LilyGO T-Dongle-S3
boards.notes: USB stick with display and button; no PSRAM, so videos are limited.

boards.name: LilyGO T-Dongle-C5
boards.notes: USB stick with display, button and a web UI on its own access point.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-NANO
boards.notes: Ethernet; Wi-Fi and BLE through the ESP32-C6 co-processor; web UI over Ethernet.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH
boards.notes: W5500 Ethernet (optional PoE module), microSD in SPI mode, web UI over Ethernet; mains or PoE power.

boards.name: ESP32-WROOM-32D + SPI microSD
boards.notes: Low-cost classic ESP32 dev board with an external microSD reader on SPI (power the reader from 5 V); 4 MB flash, no PSRAM: thumbnails only, no videos or web UI; mains power.
